about: avenDB's performance gates, held by scripts/ci/avendb-bench.mjs to the lines of crates/avendb/tests/bench_gates.rs and crates/avendb-server/tests/relay_bench.rs (the bench job of avendb-checks.yml). A gate missed fails the PR; a target is printed with whether it is met. Gates sit at the level reached on 2026-10-27 with headroom for a shared runner; raise one when the code reaches past it. The carriers' gates are 0 until a CI run measures them.
